name: Paladin
description: A holy knight who balances frontline combat with divine healing — jack of two trades, master of neither.
lore: Paladins of the Silver Order swear an oath to protect the innocent. Their holy power lets them both absorb blows and mend wounds, though they lack the specialization of a dedicated Warrior or Cleric.

abilities.name: Holy Strike
abilities.description: A weapon strike infused with holy energy. Scales with Phys ATK + 30% Mag ATK. +50% vs undead/demons.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
abilities.description: Lays hands on an ally to restore HP. Weaker than a Cleric's heal but still reliable.

abilities.name: Holy Shield
abilities.description: Raises a radiant shield. +40% Physical DEF and reflects 10% damage for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Consecrate
abilities.description: Holy AoE that damages all enemies and heals all allies for 10% of damage dealt.

abilities.name: Guardian Aura
abilities.description: All allies gain +10% Physical Resistance and +5% Fire/Ice Resistance for 4 turns.

abilities.name: Righteous Fury
abilities.description: Passive: +30% Phys ATK when any ally is below 30% HP. Killing an enemy heals Paladin for 15 HP.

abilities.name: Divine Judgement
abilities.description: Ultimate: 3x holy damage (6x vs undead/demons), stuns 1 turn, heals all allies 25% max HP.

synergies: Warrior: Double tank comp — Guardian Aura stacks with Shield Wall
Mage: Guardian Aura resistances + emergency healing keeps the glass cannon alive
Cleric: Paladin off-heals let the Cleric focus on bigger heals
weaknesses: Master of none — worse tank than Warrior, worse healer than Cleric
Mediocre damage since STR and INT are split
MP drains fast trying to both tank and heal
Low DEX means slow turn order and low crit
hire_description: A knight in gleaming silver armor kneels in prayer near the guild shrine. Rising, they turn with quiet confidence. "My oath is to defend those who cannot defend themselves. If your cause is just, my sword and faith are yours."
